limitations: Does not describe the joint cycle spectrum of a complete mapping and its orthomorphism.

scientific_integrity: The formal theorem is proved for every nonempty finite band. Independent finite cases corroborate the algebraic argument but do not prove the universal assertion. Prior existence and band-decomposition results are credited; historical priority beyond the checked literature remains qualified.
title: Orthomorphism fibers and cycle spectra of finite bands
